chunks: Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام was asked about a man who bought something from the covering of the Kaʿbah, then fulfilled some need with part of it, while some of it remained in his possession: is its sale permissible?
He said: “He may sell what he wishes, gift what he does not want, benefit from it, and seek its blessing.”
It was said: “May the deceased be shrouded in it?” He said: “No.”

key_terms.يَهَبُ: he gives it as a gift

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell or use a piece of the Kaʿbah’s covering, and may a deceased person be shrouded in it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding cloth from the Kiswah of the Kaʿbah that has been purchased lawfully. It permits selling, gifting, and benefiting from it, as well as seeking blessing through it, but prohibits using it as a shroud for the deceased.
